mapper.update:
MERGE INTO medications M
USING (
SELECT
#{itemSeq} AS item_seq,
#{ediCode} AS edi_code,
#{itemName} AS item_name,
#{entpName} AS entp_name,
#{className} AS class_name,
#{materialName} AS material_name,
#{etcOtcCode} AS etc_otc_code,
#{isDiscontinued} AS is_discontinued
FROM dual
) API
/* * ITEM_SEQ가 같다면 * 같은 의약품으로 판단 */ ON ( M.medication_id = API.item_seq )
/* * 기존에 존재하는 의약품 */ WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
M.edi_code = API.edi_code,
M.item_name = API.item_name,
M.entp_name = API.entp_name,
M.class_name = API.class_name,
M.material_name = API.material_name,
M.etc_otc_code = API.etc_otc_code,
M.is_discontinued = API.is_discontinued,
M.updated_at = SYSDATE
/* * 실제 데이터가 하나라도 변경된 경우에만 * UPDATE를 실행한다. * * 따라서 매주 API 동기화를 했다는 이유만으로 * updated_at이 변경되지 않는다. */ WHERE
NVL(M.edi_code, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.edi_code, '#NULL#')
OR
NVL(M.item_name, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.item_name, '#NULL#')
OR
NVL(M.entp_name, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.entp_name, '#NULL#')
OR
NVL(M.class_name, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.class_name, '#NULL#')
OR
NVL(M.material_name, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.material_name, '#NULL#')
OR
NVL(M.etc_otc_code, '#NULL#') <> NVL(API.etc_otc_code, '#NULL#')
OR
M.is_discontinued <> API.is_discontinued
/* * DB에 존재하지 않는 신규 의약품 */ WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
medication_id,
edi_code,
item_name,
entp_name,
class_name,
material_name,
etc_otc_code,
is_discontinued,
updated_at
)
VALUES (
API.item_seq,
API.edi_code,
API.item_name,
API.entp_name,
API.class_name,
API.material_name,
API.etc_otc_code,
API.is_discontinued,
SYSDATE
)
